body_text: Our curriculum is built on inquiry. Children explore the world through six areas of learning, woven together through themes and real experiences, never taught as isolated subjects.
title: Create
text: I wonder. I imagine. I ask.
text_2: I play. I investigate. I discover.
text_3: I think. I share. I make meaning.

items.title: Language & Literacy
items.text: Listening, speaking, stories, Letterland phonics and early reading and writing.

items.title: Mathematical Thinking
items.text: Number sense, patterns, shapes and measurement through hands-on, Singapore Math-inspired experiences.

items.title: Understanding the World
items.text: Nature, people, communities and simple experiments.

items.title: Creative Development
items.text: Art, music, dance, drama and construction.

items.title: Physical Development
items.text: Gross and fine motor skills through movement and outdoor play.

text_4: Inspired by the Super 3 approach and thoughtfully adapted for young children.
